entities.summary: Matthew Robert Boyd is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Chicago Cubs of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Toronto Blue Jays, Seattle Mariners, Detroit Tigers, and Cleveland Guardians.
